feeds.title: The Vintage Kitchen
feeds.description: Here in The Vintage Kitchen, we are on a mission to discover those fascinating details that have laid the groundwork for what, where, why, and how we cook today. Highlighting vintage culinary creativity in a variety of ways from interior design to interviews, gardening to gadgets, travel to techniques, recipes to restaurants, and all those lovely china pieces in-between we discover how the past connects us to the present when it comes to the kitchen.

feeds.title: Lost Recipes Found
feeds.description: Everyone has favorite recipes they've loved and lost in a lifetime. This site exists to help find, test, photograph and share them. Reconnecting home cooks with vintage recipes worth reviving, telling the stories behind those recipes, and showcasing them with beautiful, original photography

feeds.title: Vintage Recipe Cards
feeds.description: Vintage Recipe Cards covers articles on vintage recipe cards, guides, cooking, contemporary classics, party ideas and more.

feeds.title: Vintage Cookbook
feeds.description: Vintage Cookbook has been selling antique, vintage, rare first edition American cookbooks online since 1996, keeping prices affordable with our small town overhead, prices made possible because VintageCookbook.com lives in the workroom at the back of my house in Baraboo, Wisconsin.

feeds.title: Retro Recipe Box
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sandy. Welcome to Retro Recipe Box, where I am bringing you deliciously easy recipes. Using the stovetop, oven, slow cooker, Instant Pot, and even my cast iron skillet to cook family-friendly recipes you will love!

feeds.title: Vintage Kitchen Notes
feeds.description: A baker for more than 30 years, I want to encourage you to go into the kitchen, bake away, and have fun while doing it. I'm mostly self-taught, which means I made all the mistakes and now have tips and tricks to share with you. That's what this place is all about: easy recipes with simple ingredients and detailed instructions.

feeds.title: Grandma's Vintage Recipes
feeds.description: This blog is for the posting of Vintage Recipes. I have inherited recipes from both my grandmothers, mother, aunts, etc over the years. I am also a cookbook collector with several old cookbooks in my possession. My goal here is to share with you older recipes that have been lost to many. I hope you will enjoy my blogs and some old memories will be revived by some of the recipes.

feeds.title: Inherited Recipes
feeds.description: Baking my way through my Grandma's recipe collection. I bake in my free time all thousands of recipes and recipe books that I inherited from my grandma, follow along as I bake my way through her collection.

feeds.title: Vintage Recipes and Cookery Blog
feeds.description: This blog is about how the food was prepared and cooked in the 1800s. Find vintage recipes and more on Vintage Recipes and Cookery Blog.

feeds.title: Retro Food For Modern Times
feeds.description: Welcome to Retro Food For Modern Times. I'm Taryn, a lover of all things vintage but particularly clothes, homewares, and old cookbooks. Bringing the past back, one recipe at a time. It Covers 1970s recipes, cocktails, retro foods, salad recipes, and more.

feeds.title: Quaint Cooking
feeds.description: I am Bonnie and this is my blog Quaint Cooking which is all about vintage foods. I write about the history and origins of popular dishes as well popular food trends throughout the 20th century. I also highlight vintage cookbooks and their authors. Some might be familiar while others have possibly been forgotten throughout the decades.

feeds.title: My Vintage Cooking
feeds.description: Hi there. I'm Saara and this is my little corner to nourish some lifelong curiosities. Please take a seat at the table to enjoy classic recipes, food history, and Nordic culinary heritage. Here at My Vintage Cooking, I also serve you a complete course on moody food photography.

feeds.title: The Vintage Fork Blog
feeds.description: I'm Liz, a thirty-something-year-old living in Lafayette, La. I am a board-certified Physician Assistant by day, and a self-taught cook and baker by night and weekend. I am completely food and travel obsessed. I love putting my spin on new and old recipes as well as experimenting on my own developments. I hope this blog inspires you to explore new places in and out of the kitchen.

feeds.title: Hauntingly Good and Vintage Recipes from Long Ago
feeds.description: Old, and vintage recipes just like grandma use to make are found here.

feeds.title: Heritage Recipe Box
feeds.description: Heritage Recipe Box brings you vintage American recipes and the stories behind them.

feeds.title: La Retro Recipe
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Hannah. I read about food, I make food, I eat food, and I nap. I have a love for vintage recipes and kitchenware. I live in Detroit, Michigan.

feeds.title: From Dill to Dracula
feeds.description: My name is Ashley, and welcome to my food and folklore blog. Join me on my journey to reconnect with my heritage through traditional Romanian meals, recipes that haven't changed for centuries, and the folklore that's deeply embedded in the country and in my heart.
